rowText.steps: With a reply open, focus the question row, read its on-screen rectangle against the Retry icon's rectangle.
rowText.expected: Earlier reads found it 67-78% visible, covered by the corner icon both directions of the walk. Confirm the percentage on the current build.

buildOnDeck: bonsAI v0.5.0 (read from Quick Access panel labels)

reads.overlapAreaPct: about 6% of the question row's box sits under the retry icon's box (the icon is 20px wide inside a 254px-wide row)

verdictSentence: On this build the question text 'how do i beat the gonarch in black mesa' reads fully next to the retry icon in the screenshot -- the icon sits in its own small space on the left and only touches about 6% of the row's box, not the 67-78% covered that was measured before, so this looks fixed now.
